guidance.bestFor: A sidebar beside a content pane, split 25 to 75, with a plain 1px divider dragged left and right

whenNotToUse.when: A header pane stacked above the content, dragged up and down

guidance.bestFor: A side pane beside a column that splits again into top and bottom, 3 panes in 2 directions on plain line dividers

agentNotes: The pill on `ResizableHandle` is drawn upright and does not rotate like the `withHandle` grip, so a stacked group needs its h and w classes swapped

agentNotes: Both handles share `pillClasses`, an upright pill; under a vertical `orientation` it needs its h and w swapped, as in `c-resizable-8`

whenNotToUse.when: A 3 pane layout where one column also splits into top and bottom

guidance.bestFor: Live percentage readouts in each pane, fed from the group layout callback into React state as the divider moves
agentNotes: `setSizes` stores the whole `layout`, keyed by each panel `id`, so rename `left` and `right` in the ids and the readouts together
`onLayoutChange` runs `setSizes` on every pointer move of a drag; save a layout from onLayoutChanged, which fires once the pointer is released
The `sizes` seed and the readout fallbacks repeat the 30 and 70 of `defaultSize`, so change all 3 places together
